items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: when I got to King Alvarez's band, he said, forget it. He said, you come here with that band.

ctx.x: Do you speak French yourself? You speak Creole?

No. A little bit I did know when I got to King Alvarez's band, he said, forget it. He said, you come here with that band. He said, these boys be mad in this band. Yeah. He said, most of those fellas, they were from up north. Yeah. New York, you mean. And they always thought you was talking about them. Mm-hmm. So, you know, it was, you speak, Mr.
But you could understand if I said something like, come on, say, yay.
